text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I know I'm still missing something...
Something
important...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Oi Racecourse. Dirt. A track so close
and yet so
far, like a foreign land.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby. It feels kinda
different
from the central races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the sweltering heat of
summer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The track, the scenery, the turf, and the
dirt are
all different too. But even if
those are all
different...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if everyone's feelings stay the
same.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was just thinking... each race I've
seen has
been something big and
special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup is an important goal
for
milers—a highlight of their youth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is the stage for
Opera O's
and Doto's showdown...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I thought that's why they were so

exciting—because they all just happened
to be
special, high-profile turf races.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But... if the runners today hold that same
intensity
here at a dirt race, which is
different in almost
every way...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Then I think I can say I've grasped the
true,
underlying reason why Umamusume
are so
special.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Today is my chance to make certain!
Together
with the dirt Umas here in Oi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, in the Derby of dirt racing, she
will find
the answer she seeks.
